<observations>
Date: May 4, 2026
* 🔴 (07:05) User wants a modern island with an integrated sink.
* 🟡 (07:30) Agent identified a $515 36-inch undermount stainless sink with a quiet disposal system and scheduled a virtual demo for 2 PM.
* 🔴 (10:00) User stated the general contractor quoted $18,400 for the remodel.
* 🔴 (11:05) User approved a matte black faucet with a pull-out spray head and requested a matching soap dispenser after reviewing a design overlay.
* 🟡 (18:05) Agent contacted plumbing subcontractor GreenPipe Co. to confirm availability next week.
* 🔴 (20:20) User set a deadline to finalize all fixture selections by May 10, 2026.

Date: May 7, 2026
* 🔴 (07:12) User prefers a brushed nickel finish for cabinet hardware.
* 🟡 (07:45) Agent identified a $275 dimmable RGB LED under-cabinet lighting kit from LumiBright Co. and scheduled a virtual walkthrough for 3 PM.
* 🔴 (11:30) User approved a 2-cm quartz waterfall edge countertop from StoneCraft Ltd. ($4,200 estimate) after reviewing a 3-D render.
* 🟡 (14:35) Agent confirmed countertop delivery for May 15, 2026 (9 AM-12 PM).
* 🔴 (15:20) User requested a matching backsplash tile, and Agent identified a herringbone subway tile from TileMosaic Inc. costing $1,150.
* 🔴 (16:30) User stated the revised contractor quote is $21,250.
* 🔴 (17:00) User set a new internal deadline to finalize backsplash selection by May 12, 2026.

Date: May 10, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User expressed interest in adding a pull-out pantry drawer to the lower cabinets.
* 🟡 (07:45) Agent identified a 24-inch pull-out pantry unit from KitchenPro Supplies.
* 🟡 (08:55) Agent recommended "Arctic Fog" paint from ColorWave ($45/gallon) for its low VOC rating and scheduled a virtual color-consultation for 2 PM.
* 🔴 (10:45) User asked about a pot-filler faucet; Agent received a $420 quote for model PF-250 from FaucetWorks Ltd.
* 🟡 (12:35) Agent sourced a compact under-counter fridge (ChillBox CB-300, $1,120) and a self-watering herb kit (GreenThumb, $85) for a snack station and windowsill garden.
* 🔴 (15:15) User set a firm deadline to finalize all appliance selections by May 18, 2026.

Date: May 13, 2026
* 🔴 (07:30) User confirmed they want a "Calacatta Gold" finish quartz countertop for the island.
* 🟡 (08:10) Agent received a quote of $4,750 for a 12-ft Calacatta Gold quartz slab from StoneWorks Quarry and scheduled a site visit for May 15 at 9 AM for measurements.
* 🔴 (10:35) User asked about brushed nickel finish complementing existing stainless-steel appliances; Agent found matching cabinet handles ($12 each).
* 🟡 (12:30) Agent arranged a temporary pet-care kit ($85) for the user's cat, Luna, during construction.
* 🔴 (13:05) User set a new milestone to approve all lighting selections by May 16, 2026.
* 🟡 (13:45) Agent compiled three LED under-cabinet lighting options from BrightBeam, highlighting a dimmable 3000K strip ($68 per fixture).
* 🔴 (14:10) User set a rule: always send photos before any wall is opened up.
* 🟡 (14:20) Agent sent a 3-D render showing the island with selected quartz, new handles, and proposed lighting layout.
* 🟡 (15:40) Agent sourced a compact wine cooler (VinoVault VC-210, $920) for the pantry.

Date: May 17, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User confirmed selection of matte white cabinets from Oakridge Cabinets, model 'LunaSeries' ($1,850 each), with delivery by June 5.
* 🔴 (08:55) User asked about 'Arctic Pearl' glass subway tile backsplash; Agent found a 12-sq-ft pack at $42.
* 🟡 (10:40) Agent added a built-in coffee station to the kitchen layout.
* 🟡 (11:15) Agent scheduled an electrical inspection with CityPower for May 20 at 2 PM.
* 🔴 (11:50) User requested a plumbing permit by May 22; Agent submitted the application (confirmation PR-2026-517).
* 🟢 (13:00) User will be out of town May 24-26 and requested no noisy demolition; Agent moved wall removal to May 27 at 8 AM.
* 🟡 (14:10) Agent ordered matte black faucet handles (FlowDesign 'Eclipse', $135).
* ✅ (14:45) Agent uploaded a revised 3-D kitchen model showing cabinets, backsplash, coffee station, and new faucet for user review.

Date: May 21, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User confirmed selection of a light gray "RiverEdge" quartz countertop from StoneCraft ($3,200 per slab).
* 🟡 (08:15) Agent ordered three countertop slabs, scheduling delivery for June 8.
* 🔴 (08:50) User asked about brushed nickel pendant lights; Agent identified three "Nimbus" pendants ($89 each) with a 3-week lead time.
* 🔴 (09:55) User prefers a built-in 12-bottle wine cooler (ChillBox C12) in the island.
* 🟡 (11:05) Agent booked a plumbing rough-in inspection with WaterWorks Services for May 28 at 10 AM.
* 🔴 (11:40) User requested EcoTemp smart thermostat integration; Agent ordered an EcoTemp Pro (ET-2026-09) and scheduled installation for June 15.
* 🟡 (13:20) Agent programmed the Nimbus pendants with a Zig-Bee dimmer module.
* ✅ (14:00) Agent uploaded a revised floor plan showing the countertop, island wine cooler, and lighting scheme for user review.
* 🟡 (14:30) Agent sent a summary email with next milestones: countertop delivery June 8, lighting installation June 13, thermostat setup June 15.
* 🔴 (18:00) User stated the appliance allowance is $6,300.
</observations>
<current-task>
Primary: Finalize remaining selections for the kitchen remodel, specifically focusing on appliances within the $6,300 allowance.
Secondary: Await user review of the revised floor plan and 3-D kitchen model.
</current-task>
<suggested-response>
The assistant should wait for the user to respond to the uploaded revised floor plan and 3-D kitchen model.
</suggested-response>
